body:
## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Workflow column to runs list and drop Duration by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/576
* feat(ui): friendly labels for every workbench MCP tool by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/577
* chore(deps): update dependency node to v24.22.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/578
* fix(claude-code): report an inconclusive startup probe as warning when no server-side ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set by @paoloantinori in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/535
* fix(agents): share one bounded CLI runner across agent checks and runs by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/579
* Workbench: show assistant subagents / background tasks / todos as a compact strip (#525) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/580
* Run labels as a list of strings, labeled from their subscription (#526) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/581
* ShellContext: placeholders inside comments are no longer substituted as live code by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/582
* Gate the UI on engines[].available and Node.js; stop downgrading engine errors by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/583
* docs: agent tools can read every secret on the action type, including the model key by @paoloantinori in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/584
* MCP servers: service layer and validation (#586) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/600
* MCP servers: return serverEnv; args/env can be cleared (#587) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/601
* MCP servers: unify resolution and config generation (#590) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/602
* MCP servers: transport, headers, timeout, enabled flag, timestamps (#588) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/603
* MCP servers: ${secret:NAME} references in env and headers (#589) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/604
* OpenCode tasks: MCP server edits and deletes take effect (#591) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/605
* Action types: explicit mcpServers field (#593) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/606
* MCP servers: no implicit loading; external servers get only their own env (#592) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/607
* MCP servers: usage, blocked deletes, rename cascade, validation (#594) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/608
* MCP servers: test connection and list tools (#595) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/609
* MCP servers: rework the list, detail and create UI (#596) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/610
* Configuration packs: MCP server validation, conflict modes, credential warnings (#597) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/611
* MCP servers: catalog search and guided install of popular servers (#599) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/612
* MCP servers: end-to-end test and user documentation (#598) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/613
* Startup checks for optional MCP runtimes (npx, uvx, docker) on /engine (#614) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/615
* Epic #585: usable MCP server management by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/616
* Update dependency @vitejs/plugin-react to v6.2.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/620
* Update dependency @vitejs/plugin-react to v6.2.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/621
* Update dependency @xyflow/react to v12.12.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/622
* Update dependency vitest to v5.1.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/624
* Script tools and MCP servers get only their own declared environment by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/623
* Register per-task MCP managers in AgentRegistry so OpenCode tasks get their MCP servers by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/626
* Update dependency @apitomy/flow-ui to v3.0.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/627
* Fix MCP server management issues found in manual QA by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/628


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/compare/v3.0.1...v3.0.2
